Text: Lord of unfailing love, Your beloved children ask that You keep us in Your heart as You pour out Your mercy. [t] For all our hope rests in Your heavenly grace. [*] That You will keep us, now and forever, under Your constant protection
Changes: 2024-02-03 - Paul Prins: Updated this prayer to stylistically align.
